name: Negotiate Raise
description: Guides the user through a structured raise negotiation process from performance documentation through follow-up conversation, chaining 4 atomic skills in sequence. Covers timing (annual review vs. ad-hoc), leverage type (internal-only vs. competing offer), and outcome handling (full approval, partial offer, or denial). Use when the user wants to negotiate a raise or promotion at their current employer. Do NOT use for job offer salary negotiation (use land-new-job workflow), freelance rate increases (use start-freelancing workflow), or career pivots (use switch-careers workflow).
